effect_entries.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Le Pokémon utilise la Force Z pour s’élancer à toute vitesse sur l’adversaire. La puissance varie selon celle de la capacité originale.
The user builds up its momentum using its Z-Power and crashes into the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.
